notes: Germany 2026-27 is year 2 of the DFL 2025-26 to 2028-29 domestic cycle: Sky (Fri, Sat 15:30 single matches, Sat 18:30, Supercup, relegation), DAZN (Sat 15:30 Konferenz, all Sunday matches), SAT.1 free-to-air (9 matches incl. opener, Supercup and relegation; also free on Joyn/ran.de) and, new for 2026-27, RTL free-to-air (10 matches, 5 per half-season, after RTL Group's takeover of Sky Deutschland). ARD/ZDF/Sport1 hold highlights only. Sky's and DAZN's DFL packages also cover Austria, Switzerland, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg (and South Tyrol / Eastern Belgium for Sky). bundesliga.com's official broadcaster finder is a dynamic page whose per-country data could not be read, and its network blocked repeated fetches; the most complete per-country list available was the Spanish Wikipedia annex of Bundesliga broadcasters (last edited 24 Oct 2026), which cites DFL press releases. Entries based only on that annex where the underlying deal predates 2026-27 are flagged in their notes as not independently confirmed for 2026-27. Iran (Gem Sport, Persiana Sports, cited only via Instagram schedule posts) was left out because it is unclear whether those channels hold official rights. Known 2026-27 changes: USA Sports/Telemundo replace ESPN in the US; Fox replaces Sky Mexico in Mexico/Central America; AIS replaces beIN/PPTV in Thailand; Zee replaces OneFootball's Bundesliga Pass in India; Brazil has new multi-platform deals from 2026-27. South America (Spanish-speaking): ESPN's deal was titled 'until 2026' and no 2026-27 successor was found.

broadcasters.note: Sky: Friday 20:30, Saturday 15:30 single matches, Saturday 18:30 top match, Supercup and relegation (WOW is Sky's streaming service). DAZN: Saturday 15:30 Konferenz and all Sunday matches, plus re-live of all matches. Free-to-air for selected matches only: SAT.1 shows 9 matches per season (opener Bayern v Stuttgart, Supercup, all relegation matches, matches around the winter break), also streamed free on Joyn/ran.de. RTL shows 10 matches per season (5 per half-season), simulcast with Sky. ARD (Sportschau), ZDF (aktuelles sportstudio) and Sport1 show highlights only, no live matches.

Sky Deutschland's 2025-26 to 2028-29 DFL package explicitly covers Austria (Sky Österreich); DAZN's Saturday Konferenz and Sunday package covers the German-speaking territories per the es.wikipedia annex. sportabo.at (Oct 2026) lists Sky, WOW and DAZN for 2026-27. No free-to-air live coverage found.

German-speaking territories package 2025-26 to 2028-29: DAZN (Sunday matches + Saturday Konferenz) and Sky Sport Bundesliga (Friday, Saturday and midweek matches). Blick (30 Apr 2026) confirms the Bundesliga is 'largely' with DAZN in Switzerland. blue Sport does not show the Bundesliga. No free-to-air live coverage found.

Sky and DAZN via the German-speaking territories packages (2025-26 to 2028-29). Play Sports (Telenet) via its four-year Belgium/Luxembourg deal announced May 2025.

2026-27: Sky Sports has all Saturday top matches (17:30). Prime Video has all Sunday matches on a pay-per-view basis (UK only). Free for Friday-night matches only: BBC streams them on iPlayer and BBC Sport digital, the Samsung TV Plus FAST channel carries them, That's Football streams 15 as YouTube watch-alongs and Jamie Vardy's channel streams 7.

The Samsung TV Plus FAST channel launched for the UK and Ireland in Dec 2025 (Friday-night matches). The BBC's Friday-night digital coverage was announced for 'UK and Ireland' in Aug 2025, but the es.wikipedia annex lists BBC iPlayer for the UK only. Prime Video PPV is UK only.

New from 2026-27, replacing ESPN. English: Versant's USA Sports has at least 30 matches per season on USA Network, and all other matches stream free on Fandango. Spanish: Telemundo has more than 100 matches per season split across Telemundo (a free over-the-air broadcast network, so selected matches only) and Universo (cable), with all matches streaming on Peacock.
The es.wikipedia annex groups Puerto Rico with the US deals (USA Network/Fandango and Telemundo). Not separately confirmed by the Bundesliga release.

DAZN extended for two more seasons in Aug 2025 (every match, including the 2026 Franz Beckenbauer Supercup), which covers 2026-27. OneSoccer became an official, non-exclusive broadcast partner from Nov 2025 (every Bayern match plus other matches); its 2026-27 status is not explicitly confirmed.

Fox deal runs 2026-27 to 2030-31 and replaces Sky Mexico. It covers all 306 league matches, the Supercup and the relegation play-offs, with English and Spanish commentary. Tubi is Fox's free ad-supported streamer; the source does not say how many matches are on Tubi.
